white-glazed-doughnut.name: white-glazed doughnut
white-glazed-doughnut.traits: one ring doughnut, thick ivory-white glaze (never beige or warm) covering the top and running down the sides in soft drips, golden-brown fried dough showing at the bottom edge and inside the hole, thin milk-chocolate lines drizzled diagonally from upper left to lower right, about ten lines, some doubled; the same size as in her photo.
white-glazed-doughnut.source: her own photo (scrollcraft/builds/bake-away/gen/film-brief.md:13-18); the first take came out beige and too big (film-brief.md:91)
